method: CUA actual browser UI flows; manually observed, not an unattended regression script
checks: Original version-7 battle loads with no formation controls
Left-drag selects four friendly destroyers without moving the camera
Shift click adds Helena to selection then removes her on a second click
Box containing both sides selects all twelve own ships and excludes enemies
Right-click assigns independent movement to twelve own ships; oil changes from 50 to 20 and combat actions remain unchanged
Completed ship berths are separate; selected names and health bars remain attached
Handover clears multi-selection and lists only the incoming players ships
Box selects only three airborne squadrons
Right-click sends all three squadrons to a common region with separate destinations; oil stays 41 and endurance stays four turns
Shift click adds Enterprise to the three selected squadrons
Mixed selection receives one common movement order; one ship spends four oil, all three squadrons move in realtime
Escape clears both ship and aircraft selections
Original 256x256 four-player battle restored after all tests; round one, 50 oil, no airborne squadrons
limits: Middle-button camera drag was implemented but not exercised by the available browser drag API.
Large unit counts, full-match balance and networking were not tested.
